cix_bundle_policy.policy: The bundle records original CIX provenance. Internally TF-A and OP-TEE remain separate components so each can later be carried forward against newer Arm upstream releases.

tf-a_v2.7_to_cix_1.2.assessment: Moderate vendor delta; suitable for component layering and possible future Arm uplift.

op_tee_3.17.0_to_cix_1.2.assessment: Larger vendor delta but still recognisable as an Arm OP-TEE derived tree; keep component linkage.

rendering_requirements: recursively materialize submodules at every depth
produce ordinary files rather than gitlinks
remove active root .gitmodules files from rendered branches
store original submodule metadata in reports/manifests
preserve upstream/vendor source linkage in manifests and commit trailers
normal git log <path> and git blame <path> must work from any directory inside the repo
